parsed.reason: Correct language and facts, no names or other families, no invented promises beyond "only if a good match comes up". Weaknesses: "我会在有合适的家庭时再告诉你" is slightly first-person promise but matches the facts; "直接告诉我就行" is fine. Tone is warm but a bit stiff/formal in places ("双方家庭都同意同一次介绍"). Doesn't clearly say no search to report on, which is fine since not asked. Mostly acceptable; ranked middling for stiff phrasing and the "我会" framing sounding like a personal commitment.
